note: Input-controlled header dimensions and pixel size determine the heap allocation and later copy bounds.
The decoded pixel buffer is allocated using the computed size.
Each output row is addressed for per-pixel writes during conversion.

The implementation assumes the decoded source buffer and destination scanline both contain at least tga.width pixels, but the earlier size calculation can under-allocate when the header values are inconsistent.
The conversion loop reads pixel triplets from the heap buffer and can step past the allocated region when the size invariant is violated.
